_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to config/companies.json, or just run: python3 scripts/resolve-ats.py --from-config (it creates the file for you). companies.json is gitignored; this example is committed.

_how_it_works.1: Put company NAMES in config/user.json -> target.target_companies[]. Names only — never slugs.
_how_it_works.3: The resolver probes Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee for each name and writes the resolved platform+slug here.
_how_it_works.4: Anything it can't resolve lands as status:'unresolved' — give it a careers_url by hand with --set-careers.
_how_it_works.5: scripts/ats-fetcher.py reads ONLY this file. No company is hardcoded anywhere in the codebase.

_status_values.verified: Auto-resolved by probing a live ATS board. Re-checked by --refresh.
_status_values.manual: Pinned by hand with --set. --refresh will never overwrite it.
_status_values.unresolved: No public ATS board found — company uses an internal ATS. Set careers_url.

example-internal-ats-company.name: Example Internal ATS Company
example-internal-ats-company.note: Internal ATS — job-aggregator will point you at the careers page instead of fetching.
